note: Exploratory challenger fixed in prereg/ML_PLAN.md before any ML run. Not part of F1 or F2. Actuals are latest revised data, not first releases.

band.method: rolling quantiles of the model's errors public by the issue date, last 36 months

winner.rule: ml or blend replaces drivers only if its dev MAE on log kg at h=0 is at least 2% lower (prereg/ML_PLAN.md)

areas.reason: an area's season needs 24 usable months; areas with many zero-harvest months rarely or never reach it

national_label: Sum of areas 2-12, the areas forecast every month (areas [1, 13] excluded)

current.status: unverifiable until the Directorate publishes each month
